name: mailshield-ai
description: AI-Powered Email Threat Detection, GeoLocation & Forensic Intelligence Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "PYTHON-BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "yellow.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run backend:python" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:python: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "PYTHON-BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "yellow.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run backend:python" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:node: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "NODE-BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
